statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-34040 (GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, GO-2026-4887): with a specially crafted API request, an attacker could make the Docker daemon forward a request to an authorization (AuthZ) plugin without its body, so a plugin that inspects request bodies could allow a request it would otherwise deny. It is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-41110. The flaw is in the daemon's AuthZ plugin support, Ctx.AuthZRequest, drainBody and isChunked in the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker and github.com/moby/moby (every version in GO-2026-4887; GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2 lists github.com/moby/moby before 29.3.1) and github.com/moby/moby/v2 (before v2.0.0-beta.8). Docker Engine 29.3.1 fixes it: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.3.1, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4887. The fix on the master branch is https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/e89edb19ad7de0407a5d31e3111cb01aa10b5a38 and rejects request bodies over 4 MiB. This package is the Buildx CLI plugin, a client. We read every docker-cli-buildx package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine main and security repositories (no other package is built from the docker-cli-buildx source, and the security repository has none), each matching its index checksum: 0.33.0-r1 to 0.39.1-r1, 29 aarch64 and 28 x86_64 builds (0.34.1-r0 is published for aarch64 only). Each holds one file, /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx, a Go program that is dynamically linked against musl up to 0.39.0-r0 and statically linked in 0.39.1-r0 and 0.39.1-r1. Its Go build information lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible, but the function table of every build (read from its Go pclntab) shows that the only package compiled in from that module is github.com/docker/docker/pkg/namesgenerator. No github.com/moby/moby/v2 package is present. The only other packages from the github.com/moby/moby repository come from its client and api modules (github.com/moby/moby/client and github.com/moby/moby/api), which send Engine API requests. No build has any function from the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. A byte search of every build finds no pkg/authorization package path and no AuthZRequest name. As a check, the same function-table reader and byte search find the github.com/docker/docker/pkg/authorization package and the AuthZRequest name in a test program we built for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 against the vulnerable github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible that calls (*Ctx).AuthZRequest, and find github.com/moby/moby/v2/pkg/authorization and the AuthZRequest name in /usr/bin/dockerd of the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64, which shows the search works.

CVE-2026-34040 (GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, GO-2026-4887): a specially crafted API request could make the Docker daemon forward a request to an authorization (AuthZ) plugin without its body, so a plugin that inspects request bodies could allow a request it would otherwise have denied. It is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-41110, and the vulnerable code is the daemon's pkg/authorization package (Ctx.AuthZRequest, drainBody, isChunked). Moby fixed it in 29.3.1 by rejecting AuthZ requests whose body exceeds 4 MiB: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4887, https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/e89edb19ad7de0407a5d31e3111cb01aa10b5a38. This package contains no Go program. We unpacked every published docker-dind-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 29.7.2-r0 to 29.10.0-r5 (61 builds, each for x86_64 and aarch64), after verifying each against its index checksum. Each holds three shell scripts, docker-entrypoint.sh, dockerd-entrypoint.sh and modprobe (29.7.2-r1 installs modprobe as /usr/lib/docker-dind/modprobe.sh). From 29.9.2-r9 on, each also holds an SPDX document, opt/docker/sbom/docker-dind-runtime/.spdx.docker-dind-runtime.json, which describes the programs of the packages it depends on. That document lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible among the modules of those programs. It is a JSON text file, not code. No build contains an ELF, PE or Mach-O file, a static archive or any other compiled program. The pkg/authorization code is therefore not in this package. The Docker daemon and its pkg/authorization code are shipped in the separate docker-engine package, which docker-dind depends on and which is assessed as its own owner.

CVE-2026-34040 (GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, GO-2026-4887): with a specially crafted API request, an attacker could make the Docker daemon forward a request to an authorization (AuthZ) plugin without its body, so a plugin that inspects request bodies could allow a request it would otherwise deny. It is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-41110. The flaw is in the daemon's AuthZ plugin support, Ctx.AuthZRequest, drainBody and isChunked in the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker and github.com/moby/moby (every version in GO-2026-4887; GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2 lists github.com/moby/moby before 29.3.1) and github.com/moby/moby/v2 (before v2.0.0-beta.8). Docker Engine 29.3.1 fixes it: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.3.1, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4887, https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/e89edb19ad7de0407a5d31e3111cb01aa10b5a38. We read every envoy-gateway-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 67 builds, 1.7.5-r0 to the current 1.10.0-r2, on x86_64 and aarch64 (134 packages), each against its index checksum. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/envoy-gateway. For every build we read the program's Go build information and its function table, which contains runtime.main in every build. Envoy Gateway is not the Docker daemon. The build information of builds 1.7.5-r0 to 1.7.5-r20 lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible, and builds 1.8.2-r0 to 1.10.0-r2 do not list that module at all. In the builds that list it, the only package compiled in from github.com/docker/docker is pkg/fileutils, a small file-utility package, and no build lists any module from the github.com/moby/moby repository. No build has any function from the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2, and a byte search of every build that lists github.com/docker/docker finds no pkg/authorization. name and no AuthZRequest name. The Go vulnerability database names Ctx.AuthZRequest, drainBody and isChunked in the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby and github.com/moby/moby/v2 as the vulnerable functions; only github.com/moby/moby/v2 has a fixed Go release (2.0.0-beta.8), Docker Engine 29.3.1 carries the fix, and the fix commit changes pkg/authorization/authz.go and its test file: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-x744-4wpc-v9h2, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4887, https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/e89edb19ad7de0407a5d31e3111cb01aa10b5a38. Read every published trivy-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 38 builds, 0.69.1-r0 to the current 0.74.0-r12, each for x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against the checksum in the package index. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 that keeps its symbol table. The Go build information of /usr/bin/trivy lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible in 0.69.1-r0 to 0.69.3-r7 and does not list it from 0.70.0-r0; every build lists the separate github.com/moby/moby/api and github.com/moby/moby/client modules, and none lists github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. In the builds that list it, the github.com/docker/docker packages with functions in the binary's symbol table are the Docker API client (client) and API types (api/types and its network, strslice, swarm/runtime and versions subpackages). As a positive control, the same patterns find github.com/moby/moby/v2/pkg/authorization.(*Ctx).AuthZRequest in the function table, and the package path and the name AuthZRequest in the bytes, of /usr/bin/dockerd in the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64.

No build has any function from the pkg/authorization package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2, and a byte search of every build finds no pkg/authorization. name and no AuthZRequest name.
